prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Alder Creek Electrical Distribution Substation serves approved bays/circuits; supervisory/execution/protection roles are non-substitutable. Bay Automation Controller (Juniper) sends Bay Status Digest to Station Supervisory Control System (Glasswing); executes only approved-logic/interlock/authority/mode/permissive commands, verifies outcomes, logs rejections, degrades stale points; uses Battery Load Test Record. Glasswing presents indications/results/quality; produces Alarm Acknowledgement Slip; receives Protocol Retry Summary from Station Gateway, which preserves mappings/access/timestamps and station/external boundary, reports faults without actuation. Breaker Control Unit executes/reports position/health, rejects unmet permissives; local authority/interlocks prevail. North Bay Controller/South Bay Controller retain distinct authority, coordinate shared equipment; North blocks unsafe closing/preserves local control during communications loss; South reports mode/availability. Maintenance Remote Terminal requires authorization/safeguards; receives Settings Review Receipt from Engineering Workstation, restricted to authorized revision-controlled configuration/review/export, not routine commands. Feeder Protection Relay (Tandem) independently protects/trips despite communications loss; produces Relay Diagnostic Note. North Protection Panel/Transformer Protection Panel independently protect. Satellite Time Receiver (Bluefin) supplies quality-marked time/Clock Drift Snapshot to Sequence Event Archive (Orchard), retaining ordered reconstructive evidence/backups/recovery; investigate timing concerns before analysis. Station DC System powers/monitors protection/control, retains Battery Load Test Record; confirm availability before dependent switching. Protection Relay Engineer (Larkspur) requires studies/approval/comparison/testing for revisions; reviews changes/unexplained trips/abnormal indications before protection return; records concerns; discrepancies block release. Substation Supervisor controls changes; coordinates with Switching Desk Coordinator (Keystone), producing Isolation Boundary Card, receiving Clearance Handoff Memo, reconciling switching records/authority/state/communication limits. Control Room Operator judges automation appropriateness, acknowledges/logs/verifies, obtains local confirmation of uncertain remote status, tracks disabled functions. Substation Field Crew verifies isolation/grounding/boundaries using card; reports anomalies/pauses uncertain work; Cinder verifies/reports hazards. Assess faults before restart/bypass/replacement. Tests/manual operation require approval/local checks/operator communication/calibration/stop capability; preserve energized protection. Restoration verifies indications/protection/communications/test-connection removal; Supervisor requires complete records, cleared restrictions, risk owners/dispositions. Inhibit uncertain/missing-permissive commands; verify post-outage currency; windows consider

New part:
S240: The Maintenance Remote Terminal shall use controlled access, and each maintenance session shall be attributable to an authorized user.
S241: The North Bay Controller shall be checked for expected local behavior after approved configuration work.
S242: The South Bay Controller shall be checked for expected local behavior after approved configuration work.
S243: The North Protection Panel shall remain available for independent protection functions during supervisory control interruptions.
S244: The Transformer Protection Panel shall remain within its approved settings and operating constraints during handover.
S245: Periodic operational reviews shall examine command outcomes, event records, exceptions, and corrective actions so that automation decisions remain traceable and safe.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
